# Getting help with OksaSDR

OksaSDR (the FlexRadio client for iPhone, iPad, Mac and Android in this
repository) is maintained by Niko Oksa, OH6OKSA, in his spare time.

- **How something works:** the [user manual](../docs/mobile/MANUAL.md)
  (also the app's *Manual* button).
- **Questions, tips and news of new builds:** the
  [OksaSDR Users group on Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/groups/1468327561855382)
  (for licensed radio amateurs; give your callsign when you join).
- **A problem:** right after it happens, open **Log** in the app's top row
  (on an iPhone behind **⋯**), tap **Copy** and email it to
  oh6oksa@gmail.com with your device, radio and what you were doing, or
  [open an issue](https://github.com/OH6OKSA/OksaSDR/issues/new/choose).
- **Joining the test group:** the [tester guide](../docs/mobile/TESTING.md).

The desktop AetherSDR (Linux, macOS, Windows) is a separate project with
its own support: https://github.com/aethersdr/AetherSDR
